offering_description.value: Franchises and operates Wendy's quick-service restaurants selling hamburgers, chicken sandwiches, fries and breakfast to consumers through dine-in, drive-thru and digital ordering. Most restaurants are run by franchisees who pay royalties and fees; a small share is company-operated.

primary_products.value: hamburgers; chicken sandwiches; french fries; frozen desserts; breakfast items

primary_services.value: restaurant franchising; quick-service food preparation and drive-thru service

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual consumers dining in, drive-thru, takeout and delivery; B2B: franchisees who buy franchise rights and supplies

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: franchise royalties, advertising fund contributions and franchise fees; product sales: food sold at company-operated restaurants; rental or leasing: rent from franchisees leasing restaurant properties
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; product sales; rental or leasing

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: franchisor licensing brand and system to independent franchisees; asset operator: operates company-owned restaurants serving consumers

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada and international markets across Europe, Asia, Latin America and Middle East

specialization.value: niche specialist: single quick-service hamburger restaurant brand

distribution_channels.value: own locations: franchised and company-operated restaurants with dine-in and drive-thru; online: mobile app and website ordering; third-party retail: third-party delivery platforms

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: food safety, labor and wage rules, franchise disclosure rules (FTC), nutrition labeling
